user.title: Raineworks Dashboards
user.description: Dashboards for wall panels, desktops and phones, built from what your home has. After setup, add a dashboard whose view hosts `custom:home-dashboard` or `custom:wall-panel-dashboard`.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Raineworks Dashboards is already set up.

data_description.serve_bundle: Load the dashboards on every page from this integration. Turn off only when you build and serve them yourself.
data_description.household_group: Who the dashboards list, message and assign chores to: a Warden group's members, or everyone whose person has a device tracker.
data_description.alarm_panel: The wall panels' status lights pulse red when it's triggered, amber during its delays, and show green while armed. Leave empty to use Alarmo's panel, else the first one.
data_description.bedtime_entity: While it's on, the status lights show at 10% (a triggered alarm stays bright); else this integration's Home Bedtime, when it has bedtime rooms. Doors labeled Exterior Door show amber while open.

house.title: House
house.description: What the dashboards can't find on their own. A dashboard card's own `house` option wins where both set something.

data_description.announce_speaker: Where the wall panel timer announces, and the Daily dialog's first speaker.
data_description.thermostats: The climate card's thermostats, in this order; else every thermostat.
data_description.tts_engine: The house's voice for the intercom's typed messages and camera talkback; else the first text-to-speech entity.
data_description.tts_voice: Named on every call, so a change of the engine's default never changes it.
data_description.tts_streaming: The engine speaks an answer as it's written (Assist speaks through it itself).
data_description.tts_fallback: Spoken with when the voice fails.
data_description.guest_wifi_qr: An image with the guest network's QR code (UniFi's), shown on the wall panels.
data_description.announce_speakers: Where an announcement plays when none are named; else the announcing speaker.
data_description.quiet_start: Automated announcements stay silent from this time (10 PM if empty), and while bedtime is on.
data_description.quiet_end: …until this time (7 AM if empty). A person's own announcements (the intercom, the timer) always play.
data_description.home_path: The Home dashboard's path (/dashboard-home/home): to-do pushes open their item there.

laundry.title: Laundry
laundry.description: The washer's and dryer's sensors (SmartThings names them so). A machine with all three shows in the header while it runs.

bedtime.title: Bedtime
bedtime.description: A Bedtime switch for each room picked, and Home Bedtime: every room on turns Home Bedtime on, any room off turns it off, and Home Bedtime turned on puts every room to bed. What a room's bedtime does is up to your automations (trigger on its switch). A room that had a bedtime toggle (an input_boolean labeled Bedtime, in that area) keeps its name and state.

data_description.bedtime_rooms: Each gets a Bedtime switch, in its area, labeled Bedtime.
data_description.bedtime_ends: Every room's bedtime turns off then (and so Home Bedtime).

user.title: Wall panel
user.description: A tablet on a wall showing a `custom:wall-panel-dashboard`. Pick its device and its status light, wake and reload are found on it; pick any of them yourself to override, or leave them out if the tablet has none.

data_description.name: How it's named where the shared user can't say which panel it was (who armed the alarm). Use the same name as its card's `name`.
data_description.device_id: The tablet's device (ROAMiQ, Fully Kiosk Browser, the Companion app…).
data_description.status_light: A light showing the house's status: the alarm, an exterior door open.
data_description.wake: A button or switch that turns its screen on: pressed when the doorbell rings.
data_description.reload: A button that reloads its dashboard: pressed by the reload_panels action.

reload_panels.name: Reload wall panels
reload_panels.description: Presses every wall panel's reload, so each loads its dashboard again (a new version, after a deploy).

wake_panels.name: Wake wall panels
wake_panels.description: Turns on every wall panel's screen.

set_affirmation.name: Set daily affirmation
set_affirmation.description: Stores a household member's daily affirmation (the Daily dialog shows it).

notify_people.name: Notify people
notify_people.description: Sends a push to household members' phones (their Companion apps). No people: the whole household.

people.name: People
people.description: Who to notify. Leave empty for the whole household.

exclude.name: Exclude
exclude.description: People to leave out (whoever made the change).

title.name: Title
title.description: A few words, such as who it's from.

data.name: Notification data
data.description: The Companion app's data (tag, group, channel, clickAction, url, actions, image…).

add_todo_item.name: Add to-do item
add_todo_item.description: Adds an item to a to-do list, for a household member (an 'Assigned to' line in its description) or anyone, and tells whom it's for.

person.name: Person
person.description: Who it's for; empty for anyone.

notify_todo_assignee.name: Notify to-do assignee
notify_todo_assignee.description: Pushes a to-do item to whom it's for (anyone: the household but whoever added it), with Mark done.

person.name: Person
person.description: Who it's for; empty for anyone.

item.name: Item
item.description: The item's summary (finds it without a uid).

uids.name: Item uids
uids.description: Several items at once; the item then lists their summaries.

print_note.name: Print note
print_note.description: Prints a note on the receipt printer: titled Note, who it's from and when, the message big and centered.

message.name: Message
message.description: The note (plain text: the printer has no emoji).

sender.name: From
sender.description: Who it's from; empty for no name.

printer.name: Printer
printer.description: Empty for the first receipt printer.

print_todo_list.name: Print to-do list
print_todo_list.description: Prints a to-do list's open items (or those picked) as a checklist, each with its due date and who it's for.

uids.name: Items
uids.description: The items to print (their uids); empty for every open item.

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose slip this is (their name): titled with it, their own items not repeating it.

printer.name: Printer
printer.description: Empty for the first receipt printer.
